card.name: Frequency adverbs after a verb
card.fires_on: Adverbs of frequency or timing such as daily, frequently, periodically and every, placed right after a verb or auxiliary. Also some main verbs like fell or using in general web prose.

modes.label: Frequency adverbs
modes.description: An adverb saying how often something happens, placed right after the verb.
modes.example: People with Alzheimer’s will<< frequently>> be agitated or depressed.

modes.label: Partway through infrequently
modes.description: The middle of the word infrequently in a report-rate sentence.
modes.example: although oligohydramnios has been inf<<requently>> reported as soon as 48 hours

modes.label: Verbs in news-style claims
modes.description: A verb describing a change or an activity in a place, in general web text.
modes.example: rainfall in the western Australia city of Perth<< fell>> 20%.
